subject: MdeModulePkg: Replace include guards with #pragma once
reasons: The transformation replaces #ifndef/#define/#endif preprocessor include guards with #pragma once directives, which are preprocessor constructs, not C AST nodes.
Coccinelle operates on C source code at the AST level and cannot match or rewrite preprocessor directives like #ifndef, #define, or #endif.
Although the pattern is highly repetitive (14+ commits in the series across all edk2 packages), the transformation is not expressible as an SmPL rule.
A sed/awk/Python script would be the appropriate tool for this kind of change.
